summary: Router 0.24.0, ADR-0074 and ADR-0075. Hash-locked Python: router/requirements-lock.txt (asyncpg 0.32.0, uvloop 0.23.0, paho-mqtt 2.1.0 with every SHA-256 PyPI publishes) and requirements-ci-lock.txt (31 packages, Linux CPython 3.11, resolved by pip, hashed from PyPI). New router/skirnir_router/pydeps.py (stdlib + packaging or pip's vendored copy, no package imports) plans the lock entries for requirements the interpreter does not meet and venv copies that differ from the lock, refuses unmet-and-unlocked, out-of-range, unhashed and malformed entries, and verifies afterwards. install.sh runs plan, pip install --require-hashes --no-deps of the plan, verify; it adds python3-paho-mqtt and python3-uvloop to the apt packages and copies the lock. deploy.py sends pydeps.py and the requirement files as a base64 tar on stdin to the venv step (before the swap) and installs the same way; shlex import removed. ha.py builds the MQTT client with CallbackAPIVersion.VERSION1 on paho-mqtt 2.x (capability check, no exception), so requirements.txt allows paho-mqtt>=1.6.1. New tools/security/lock_requirements.py (pin with dependency-closure refusal for Python 3.11-3.14 on Linux, resolve on Linux only, offline check, verify-pypi). CI jobs and live-memory install the CI lock with --require-hashes; the security workflow installs it, audits both locks with pip-audit --require-hashes --disable-pip and runs verify-pypi. Release provenance: new .github/workflows/release-provenance.yml (permissions contents/id-token/attestations write only in its job; tag passed through env, quoted) downloads the release's agent assets, reads version from the names and the Go toolchain from their build info, rebuilds from git archive of the tag with the release flags and GOTOOLCHAIN=local, compares SHA-256, and only on identity attests provenance (attest-build-provenance v4.2.2) and the SBOMs (attest-sbom v4.1.0, SHA-pinned) and uploads the SBOMs. New tools/security/sbom.py writes deterministic CycloneDX 1.6 (RFC 4122 uuid5 serial). Docs EN/DE (install-router, operations: verifying a release), AGENTS.md (lock commands and refresh rule), threat model and register TM-16, CHANGELOG.

findings.evidence: Production deploys installed asyncpg>=0.29,<1 from PyPI by range without hashes; CI installed every requirement file by range.
findings.resolution: Hash-locked overlay planned per host and a hashed CI lock; refusal when a requirement cannot be met from the distribution or the lock; audits and PyPI comparison weekly and on PRs.

findings.evidence: Agent binaries are built on the operator workstation; nothing linked the published bytes to the tagged source, and there was no SBOM.
findings.resolution: CI rebuild from the tag with byte comparison; provenance and SBOM attestations only for identical bytes; SBOM assets on the release. The operator signature remains the update trust anchor; no key enters CI.

findings.evidence: The new workflow holds contents: write and id-token: write.
findings.resolution: Only on release publication or manual dispatch by maintainers, in one job, no pull_request trigger, persist-credentials false, the tag only through env and quoted, actions pinned to SHAs.

tests.command: python test/selftest_pydeps.py (Windows and Linux); python test/selftest_sbom.py; python tools/security/lock_requirements.py check
pydeps plan/verify against the production router venv through deploy.py's stdin bundle (read-only, nothing installed)
tests.evidence: plan lines: 0; pydeps verify: 6 of 6 requirements met.

tests.command: python tools/security/sbom.py agent on the published 0.30.0 Linux binary (WSL, Go 1.27.3)
ruff check .; check_pinned_references; selftest_pinned_references; check_control_flow; check_adr_index; selftest_english_names; YAML parse of the changed workflows
tests.evidence: All checks passed; 0 pinned-reference findings; ADR index ok: 75 ADRs.

limitations: The provenance workflow runs only on a published release or by dispatch; its first real run is the next release (or a dispatch for v0.30.0).
The CI lock was resolved with a Python 3.13 interpreter targeting 3.11 (pip --python-version); pip checks Requires-Python for the target, markers use the running Linux system.
Dependabot does not refresh the locks; freshness depends on manual refresh, CVEs surface through pip-audit.
Merged main after the PRs below it.
